sections.label: Our Teams

briefs.headline: Reds rally from three down to beat the Padres 7-3, take the series
briefs.summary: Rookie Juan Brito's first big-league homer, a three-run shot in the third, tied it Wednesday, and Hector Rodriguez and J.J. Bleday also went deep; Brandon Williamson got the win and Casey Mize the loss as Cincinnati took two of three.

briefs.headline: Giants score twice in the 10th to beat the Pirates 5-4
briefs.summary: Pittsburgh tied it with single runs in the seventh and eighth Wednesday, but Bryce Eldridge's RBI double and a Turner Hill sacrifice fly won it in the 10th; Rafael Devers hit his 32nd homer, and Camilo Doval took the loss. The series ends today at 12:35 p.m. ET.

briefs.headline: Monaco backs out of £47M Camara sale, leaving Chelsea without an Enzo replacement
briefs.summary: Sky Sports reported Wednesday that Monaco reneged on a written club-to-club agreement before the deadline after its own Balogun-to-Everton deal collapsed; Chelsea called the conduct "extraordinary and deeply unprofessional" and go to Arsenal Sunday.

briefs.headline: Marshall's Gibson wants no repeat of last year's opener at Penn State
briefs.summary: Tony Gibson said Wednesday the Herd has "watched a ton of Iowa State tape" with 25 Cyclones following Matt Campbell to State College; Carlos Del Rio-Wilson starts at quarterback for a team that opened last season with a 38-point loss at Georgia.

briefs.headline: Bengals get Shemar Stewart back in pads; Chase and Higgins limited
briefs.summary: The second-year defensive end practiced in pads Wednesday for the first time in five weeks after a hyperextended knee; Zac Taylor said Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins are limited this week but on track for the Sept. 13 opener against Tampa Bay.

briefs.headline: WVU's first depth chart lists Hawkins or Fox at quarterback
briefs.summary: Tuesday's chart carries an "OR" at quarterback between Mike Hawkins and Scotty Fox Jr., at tight end, at kicker and at several defensive spots; Rodriguez said most are "because we feel good about multiple guys." Coastal Carolina visits Saturday at noon.

sections.label: Around the Leagues

briefs.headline: Wakatakakage sits out Aki after four operations that nearly cost his leg
briefs.summary: The two-time champion, now east maegashira 12, said compartment syndrome in his left thigh in July meant four emergency surgeries and an incision of 30 to 40 centimeters, with doctors telling him every second counted; he misses the whole basho and drops to juryo (the second division) for November.

briefs.headline: Hoshoryu will not decide on Aki until the last minute
briefs.summary: The west yokozuna, back to 148 kg at a mid-August checkup after falling to 135 following right-knee surgery, resumed shiko Tuesday and said "It's unclear until the last moment. I want to participate"; he consults Tatsunami before Friday's Yokozuna Deliberation Council practice. The basho opens Sept. 13 in Tokyo, 10 days out.

briefs.headline: Brewers beat the Cubs 9-5 to push their NL Central lead to nine
briefs.summary: Jackson Chourio had four hits at Wrigley Wednesday as Milwaukee (87-53) moved nine games clear of second-place Chicago (78-62); St. Louis beat the Dodgers 8-6 in 10 innings, and Toronto blanked Cleveland 11-0.

briefs.headline: NBA suspends Ballmer a year, strips the Clippers of five first-round picks
briefs.summary: The league fined the Clippers $30 million and Kawhi Leonard $700,000 Wednesday after finding the team helped route off-court income, including a $28 million Aspiration deal, to Leonard; the Clippers said they "vehemently reject" the findings.

waters.working: Down from 101 a day ago and thinner every morning this week - the river is a string of pools now, with the riffles between them ankle-deep. Fish it from below on your knees: a 12-foot leader, one beetle or ant dropped under the overhanging bank, and a small olive sculpin swung through the two or three plunge pools still holding depth. Sculpin and caddis are the forage here, and at this flow the caddis are what the fish see.

waters.near: 14 miles above R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 24.8 ft - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Pool water, unchanged in a day - the wing-dam tips and the riprap are the structure, shad the forage, so a white swimbait or a spoon over the tips early and a football jig dragged down the seam once the sun is on the water.

waters.near: below R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 25.8 ft and rising - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Up three-tenths in a day below the dam, so there is a little more current on the lock wall and the barge cuts - crawfish colors on a jig pitched into the cuts, and a skipjack-pattern swimbait worked along the riprap where the flow pushes bait against it.

waters.reading: Sound highs 1:17 AM at 3.4 ft and 1:57 PM at 4.3 ft at Hampstead; lows 7:36 AM at 0.4 ft and 8:45 PM at 0.9 ft.
waters.read: Fish the moving water either side of high at 1:17 AM and 1:57 PM in the sound.
waters.working: The Fisherman's Post September report, published Tuesday and two days old, has reds and specks on topwater at dock lights, creek mouths and grass banks early, flounder "going wild" at 20 to 24 inches on bucktails with soft plastics, and Spanish and blues hit-or-miss on Gotchas off the piers. Flounder want moving water on structure, so work the flood into the 1:57 PM high; reds want the last of the fall, into tonight's 8:45 PM low. Waning gibbous at 61%, easing toward the neap. Water 85.6F at Beaufort, 60 miles up the coast.
waters.note: Hampstead is the sound station and the read that matters; the oceanfront pier runs well ahead and is quoted only for a surf read. NWS Wilmington's 3:30 a.m. surf zone forecast has a moderate rip current risk on Pender beaches through this evening with 2-foot surf; today's Heat Advisory covers inland Pender and coastal Onslow, not Topsail Beach or Surf City.
